statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk is low at 12% after the Oct 7 intraday decline fully retraced into the close, while Stress stays elevated at 48% on 24-year-high long Treasury yields and broadly negative breadth.
recommendation: Tail remains well below the block threshold, so the mapped state is EA_ON for both NQ futures and NAS100 CFD. A narrow danger window is published around the Oct 8 jobless claims print and the US cash open, where conditional risk is highest. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain unaffected by this mapping.
headline: Nasdaq-100 dip fully retraces into the close as long yields hit 24-year highs
body: The Nasdaq-100 closed at 31,160.08, down 0.21%, after falling to 30,904.46 intraday and recovering to finish only 10 points below the 31,170.12 session high. A $39bn 10-year note auction eased the long end off its peak and allowed equities to pare losses. The 10-year Treasury yield reached 5.365%, its highest since April 2002, and the 30-year reached 5.732%, the highest since May 2002. The September FOMC minutes, released at 18:00Z, left yields little changed and drifting off their highs. VIX decayed to 15.08 from a 16.01 intraday print. Breadth was materially weaker than the index close implies: more than two-thirds of issues declined, the Russell 2000 fell 1.31%, and the Dow fell 0.66%. Tail risk is assessed as low because the pathological structure that matters, shallow or failed retracements and repeated extension, did not appear; the opposite occurred, with a full retracement of a 1.0% decline into the close. Stress is elevated because the environment itself is difficult: long yields at 24-year highs, Brent near $101, and a stagflationary mix of 29k September payrolls against a Fed that hiked to 3.75-4.00% in September. The Nasdaq-100 sits roughly 0.6% below its 52-week high of 31,361.37.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours carried a complete published Claude record. Scores sat at a Tail floor of 10 to 14 through the Globex evening, the Asian session and the European morning. Tail then rose to a WATCH band of 21 to 23 with a trend-down mode between 11:00Z and 14:00Z as the Nasdaq-100 fell toward its 30,904.46 session low. From 15:00Z the mode returned to mixed and Tail declined steadily to 12 as the decline retraced into the close, the 10-year auction steadied the long end, and the September FOMC minutes were absorbed without a disorderly second leg.
outlookSummary: The published 24-hour path stays in the EA_ON band throughout. Scores hold near a Tail floor of 10 to 11 across the Globex evening and the Asian session, then step up gradually through the European morning as scheduled Waller remarks and US pre-market positioning approach. Conditional risk peaks at a Tail of 17 in the 13:00Z hour, where the weekly jobless claims print at 12:30Z is immediately followed by the US cash open at 13:30Z; after a 29k September payroll print, labour data transmits directly into a long end at 24-year highs. The path then eases back through the US afternoon and returns to the overnight floor after the 20:00Z cash close. The published danger window is deliberately narrow and covers only the claims print through the first hour of cash trade. Every forward slot states conditional risk; no future price-path structure is presented as observed.
